description: This file implements systemd D-Bus subscription and event handling, including subscribing/unsubscribing to systemd signals, dispatching signals, managing unit state and property updates, and handling signal filtering and ignoring.

classes.name: Conn
classes.description: Represents a connection to systemd's D-Bus interface, managing subscriptions and signal dispatching.

classes.name: SubStateUpdate
classes.description: Data structure representing a unit's name and its substate.

classes.name: PropertiesUpdate
classes.description: Data structure holding a unit's name and its changed properties.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Sets up the connection to subscribe to systemd D-Bus signals for unit creation and property changes.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes the connection from systemd D-Bus signals.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches incoming systemd signals and processes unit state and property updates.

methods.name: SubscribeUnitsContext
methods.description: Returns channels for receiving unit status updates and errors, with customizable context and interval.

methods.name: SubscribeUnitsCustomContext
methods.description: Returns channels for unit status updates with custom buffer size, change detection, and filtering.

methods.name: SetSubStateSubscriber
methods.description: Registers channels to receive updates on unit substate changes.

methods.name: sendSubStateUpdate
methods.description: Sends an update about a unit's substate to the registered channel.

methods.name: SetPropertiesSubscriber
methods.description: Registers channels to receive updates on unit property changes.

methods.name: sendPropertiesUpdate
methods.description: Sends an update about a unit's property changes to the registered channel.

methods.name: shouldIgnore
methods.description: Determines if signals for a given unit path should be ignored based on recent unloads.

methods.name: updateIgnore
methods.description: Marks a unit path to be ignored temporarily based on its load state.

methods.name: cleanIgnore
methods.description: Cleans up expired ignore entries to prevent unbounded growth.
